title: GG 4 · Payments list: booking status and Send again
walkthroughSteps: One status column walks each payment from approval to booking.
"Send again" only on "Couldn't be booked" rows, re-sends the SAME payment (no new payment, no re-approval, no double pay-out).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Payments · Every status at a glance
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Payments list of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Every status once: Draft, Pending, Requires amendment, Rejected, Booking in progress, Booking delayed, Booked, Couldn't be booked. A "Needs you" count above the list.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Payments · Couldn't be booked, you fix it (bank details)
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Payments, row 123456-4 already open.

**You see:** Why it failed, "No money has been paid out", you need to act, link to the task, and **Send again to Global Genius** with "once you've fixed it" advice.

**Try:** Press Send again: confirm shows the same payment ("not a new payment, won't be paid twice"); it goes to Booking in progress, then Booked after ~3 seconds.
